consumer: CC-024 paid-tier decision under Jim decision 84
scope: Primary-source route comparison; no account onboarding, provider contact, payment, paid activation or schedule change.

launch.evidence: Current codex.exe command line explicitly contained --model gpt-6.1-sol and model_reasoning_effort=max; supported runtime model/effort telemetry was unavailable.

decision.reason: Patreon expressly permits the intended journalistic/analytical format and supports Vietnam payouts; Substack's domestic Stripe setup does not.

common_seller_steps.text: Use the genuine individual/business seller and its tax identity; match platform/bank ownership. Retain gross sales, fees, payouts and FX records; issue invoices required by the applicable regime. Merchant-of-record sales tax does not itself settle Vietnamese income tax. Seller form, turnover and exact paid product are not established here; no tax-rate or licensing conclusion is invented.

conditions: The first DEMO position is correctly managed, followed by a month without errors.
20-30 conditional calls are publicly scored and never edited.
4-6 weeks of publishing without a gap.
Free subscribers and pledges show willingness to pay.
decision84.operation: Everything stays free until these conditions hold. Demand measurement uses the separately approved pledge process. This review makes no charge or pledge-setting change.

method.read_clock: UTC per source; Jim-facing times use GMT+7.
method.browser: BrowserOS Neo existing window; task group 29E5AC5FB8047BD7E04F5CD94FA7208D; five owned research tabs reused; other tabs unchanged.
method.supplement: Official public-page text for PDFs and content not exposed by collapsed browser panels.
method.quote_policy: At most two short sentences and 25 quoted words per source; one fragment or sentence retained.
method.epistemic_policy: Separate provider rule facts from assessments, and country eligibility from account approval, product acceptance and payout.

routes.name: Substack paid subscriptions

payout.text: NO for Vietnam-resident seller onboarding using a Vietnamese business/bank only. Stripe is Substack's sole provider; Vietnam is absent from Stripe's merchant-country list.

fees.text: 10% Substack plus Stripe card/billing fees at the actual eligible jurisdiction's rate. There is no supported Vietnam merchant tariff for this route; iOS purchases have separate Apple economics.

identity.text: Truthful personal/business address and details, then a linked bank through Stripe. A foreign receiving-account number does not change seller residence; a separately legitimate eligible foreign entity is a different setup.

tax.text: No domestic Vietnam paid-onboarding process is available. A genuine supported-country entity would need its own tax assessment; apply the common Vietnam seller steps. This item creates no foreign entity.

content.text: Stripe's investment/brokerage and other financial-service categories require due diligence; misleading get-rich-quick schemes are barred. This does not establish a categorical ban on editorial macro analysis.

assessment.text: Replace CC-024's assumption that Jim can simply connect a Vietnamese Stripe account. Keep free Substack; use a suitable alternative for the eventual paid tier.

routes.next_action: Ops Product: use the alternative-route comparison in the paid-tier decision; no payout-setting change during this review.

routes.name: Ko-fi through PayPal

payout.text: YES in principle: Ko-fi pays into the creator's own PayPal account; PayPal publishes Vietnam commercial receipt and local-bank withdrawal routes. Verification and account limitations still apply.

fees.text: Membership/monthly tips/shop: 5% Ko-fi plus PayPal Vietnam international commercial fees of 4.40% + $0.30 for USD receipts. Withdrawal is 60,000 VND when no conversion is involved; FX/other charges are separate. The 0% Ko-fi option applies to qualifying one-time tips, not memberships.

identity.text: Use the seller's own correctly domiciled PayPal account; provide legal name, residence, birth date, national/tax identification, bank and requested business evidence. PayPal recommends a business account for primarily commercial use.

tax.text: Ko-fi is not merchant of record: seller determines registrations, adds/remits applicable VAT or sales tax and reports income. PayPal can request tax documents; apply the common Vietnam seller steps.

content.text: Ko-fi bars unlawful financial services and misleading finance claims and incorporates PayPal rules. PayPal requires approval for buying/selling/brokering investments. No blanket ban on ordinary economic journalism was found; this is an assessment, not express approval.

assessment.text: Future editorial-membership alternative after decision 84. Its lower platform fee comes with seller-operated indirect-tax administration and PayPal FX/withdrawal costs.

routes.next_action: Ops Product defines the editorial membership/tax handling; after decision 84, Jim completes any secure PayPal identity/bank step.

routes.name: Gumroad

payout.text: YES: Vietnam/VND local-bank payouts are explicitly listed. A local bank, government photo ID and residence/business evidence are required. Standard threshold is $100 equivalent; account review applies. Payoneer/Wise are expressly unsupported payout substitutes.

fees.text: Direct sale: 10% + $0.50 plus card processing of 2.9% + $0.30 or PayPal fees. Discover: 30% including processing. High-volume discounts are separate; use the standard case for a new launch.

identity.text: Select the real individual/business form; provide legal name, birth date, physical address, national ID/photo ID and applicable company registration/tax documents. Match payout country and bank.

tax.text: Gumroad handles platform transaction sales tax as merchant of record; existing reseller reporting and common Vietnam seller reporting can remain. Its broad tax marketing does not establish exemption from seller income tax.

content.text: Investment-opportunity services, crypto products and advice-framed prediction services are restricted. Rules do not expressly classify an editorial macro report; the actual six-market/conditional-call sample needs a product-specific answer if this route is selected.

assessment.text: Country payout is available; exact product fit remains unresolved. Prefer Patreon rather than assuming either acceptance of the current product or a blanket ban on financial writing.

routes.next_action: Ops Product retains as a digital-report alternative; any later provider classification request requires the actual sample and separately authorized contact. No message was sent.

routes.name: Lemon Squeezy

payout.text: YES at country level: Vietnam is explicitly listed for bank payouts. Identity, tax forms and store approval remain separate.

fees.text: Base 5% + $0.50 on total order value including tax; add 1.5% international, 1.5% PayPal and 0.5% subscriptions where applicable. Non-US bank payout: 1%; non-US PayPal: 3%, capped at $30. Optional-feature charges are separate.

identity.text: Provide personal information/government photo ID; complete store KYC/KYB and product review; bind the real bank or PayPal account.

tax.text: Complete the applicable non-US Form W-8. Merchant-of-record handling covers buyer sales tax/VAT; tax on seller payout income can remain.

content.text: Services, regulated financial activities and crypto-related products are prohibited. Fulfilled original eBooks/PDFs can be accepted if not prohibited. A standalone macro PDF differs from the ongoing six-market product, which includes Bitcoin.

assessment.text: Do not select for the current bundled six-market offering. A separate non-crypto downloadable publication is only a possible future store-review case.

routes.next_action: Ops Product retains the explicit Vietnam payout finding and selects a provider whose content rule fits the actual membership.

routes.name: Paddle

payout.text: Country eligibility exists for an accepted software supplier: Vietnam is not on its unsupported list. Monthly wire/Payoneer payouts have a $100 minimum; this is not acceptance of a financial newsletter.

fees.text: Checkout: 5% + $0.50. Certain wire payouts add $15 SWIFT plus recipient-bank costs. FX margins and other applicable fees are separate; obtain the actual corridor quote for any future eligible software product.

identity.text: KYC/KYB can include business/product URLs, business/financial details, shareholders/beneficial owners, tax status and registrations; supply genuine supplier/bank information.

tax.text: Paddle administers transaction sales tax as reseller; supplier tax-status/registration disclosures remain. Apply common Vietnam seller reporting.

content.text: Expressly bars investment/financial advice, trading signals and strategies. Its software focus also restricts pure advisory services and community access without a supported bona fide product.

assessment.text: Not suitable for the current newsletter/conditional-call offering. Country eligibility and Payoneer availability do not override its product rule.

routes.next_action: Ops Product excludes from the current membership shortlist; do not disguise an editorial subscription as software.

routes.name: Patreon

payout.text: YES: Vietnam/VND is an explicit bank destination, including USD-to-local-bank transfer via Payoneer. VND is not on the selectable creator-balance currency list; use a supported currency such as USD and distinguish conversion to the bank's VND.

fees.text: New creators: 10% platform. USD card/Apple Pay: 2.9% + $0.30; non-US PayPal/Venmo: 3.9% + $0.30. Different member/creator currency adds 2.5%. USD-to-VND bank payout: 1.55% + $0.25 ($10 minimum). Optional PayPal/Wallet and iOS costs are separate.

identity.text: Supply accurate payout country/matching account details; complete required Patreon/processor checks with legal name, birth date and requested ID/photo/business evidence. Adding/changing payout details triggers a five-day lock.

tax.text: Submit W-8BEN for the non-US individual or applicable W-8BEN-E for an entity, with genuine identity/tax details. Do not assume treaty benefits; apply common Vietnam seller reporting. Patreon collects/remits applicable member VAT where it has the obligation; local seller filings can remain.

content.text: Explicitly permits analytical, educational, journalistic and historical finance/banking/crypto discussion. Financial advice promoting/selling investments or ownership, MLM schemes and crypto launches remains barred. The membership must deliver the stated editorial product.

assessment.text: Preferred future membership candidate: Vietnam payouts and the intended finance-journalism category are expressly documented. This recommendation is not an account approval or completed payout.

routes.next_action: After decision 84, Ops Product chooses the final editorial SKU; Jim completes one secure identity/tax/own-bank onboarding flow. Verify a real first payout only once charging is authorized.

routes.name: Routes through Payoneer

payout.text: YES as a rail for an accepted platform; Vietnam is listed among bank destinations and Patreon documents Vietnam/VND. Paddle offers Payoneer for eligible suppliers. Direct Request a Payment covers supported B2B categories, not consumer checkout. It does not add Payoneer support to Gumroad/Substack.

fees.text: Platform payouts use that platform's tariff. Direct card receipts: up to 3.99% + $0.49; US ACH: 1%. Bank withdrawals vary by corridor, including published 1.2%-4% rates or conditional fixed pricing. Annual fee: $29.95 below $6,000 receipts in 12 months, with account/region exceptions. No universal VND quote is established.

identity.text: Verify real personal/business information, government ID, address and bank ownership in the Verification Center; provide requested category/invoice evidence.

tax.text: Business invoice requests can include applicable local tax; seller determines invoice/tax treatment and reports receipts under common Vietnam steps. This collection rail is not documented as remitting seller income tax.

content.text: Brokerage investment services, venture capital/investments and other restricted financial activities are excluded. Direct editorial B2B invoices require an allowed category; retail Request a Payment is expressly excluded.

assessment.text: Use the documented rail behind Patreon if selected. Direct B2B collection is conditional on the actual client/product/category; it is not a universal consumer-subscription replacement.

routes.next_action: Ops Product uses the chosen platform's payout integration; do not repurpose business invoice requests as consumer membership checkout.

routes.name: Bank transfer from Vietnamese businesses

payout.text: YES for a lawful domestic B2B sale to the seller's own VND account. Vietcombank's organisational account form supports VND. This is direct collection rather than a platform payout or automated membership service.

fees.text: Direct transfer has no platform percentage; bank/account/package and payer allocation determine costs. Published VCB DigiBiz outgoing examples: 7,000 VND same-bank; non-24/7 interbank 0.02%, min 20,000/max 1,000,000 VND. These are corporate payer examples, not Jim's quoted receiving fee; VAT/package/recipient-bank costs can differ.

identity.text: Match the contracting seller and account. An organisational account needs registered business/tax identity and legal-representative ID; corporate electronic payments require representative biometric verification. Individual-business treatment depends on the actual seller form.

tax.text: Set the real business/tax form; prepare the B2B contract, applicable invoice/e-invoice and revenue records, then file/pay under the relevant regime. No universal tax rate is established for an unidentified seller/product.

content.text: The bank rail provides no exemption for regulated advice. Securities Law Article 4(32) includes analysis/reports plus buy/sell/hold recommendations; Article 86(4) addresses licensed securities advice. This audit does not decide an unidentified SKU's legal classification.

assessment.text: Practical future domestic B2B collection for a documented editorial-content contract, with invoice/payment matching and fulfilment. It is not a turnkey recurring-subscription platform or an investment-advice licence.

routes.next_action: After decision 84, Ops Product prepares one lawful editorial contract/invoice; Jim completes any required secure seller/bank verification. Use only that seller's confirmed account.

sources.title: Stripe global availability
sources.quote: Stripe is currently supported in the following countries/regions, with more to come.
sources.finding: Vietnam is absent from the published merchant-country list. A platform paying a Vietnamese bank is a separate capability from opening a Vietnamese Stripe merchant account.

sources.title: Substack: connect Stripe and receive payments
sources.quote: Stripe is our sole payment provider
sources.finding: Substack charges 10% plus Stripe card and billing fees; onboarding requires real business/personal details and a linked bank. No PayPal or Payoneer payout replacement is offered in this guide.
sources.access: BrowserOS Neo article; saved public article read; primary web text

sources.title: Substack country limitations
sources.quote: If you have a free Substack publication, you can start from anywhere.
sources.finding: Free publication is available globally; paid subscriptions depend on supported Stripe countries, with additional Substack exceptions.

sources.title: Stripe restricted businesses
sources.quote: Financial products and services
sources.finding: Investment/brokerage and other financial services require additional due diligence; deceptive get-rich-quick schemes are prohibited. This is not blanket approval for every finance product.

sources.title: Ko-fi fees
sources.quote: A flat 5% service fee applies to anything else
sources.finding: Memberships, monthly tips and shop sales incur 5% on the free plan; one-time tips can incur 0%. Processor fees are additional.

sources.title: Ko-fi content guidelines
sources.access: BrowserOS Neo; primary web text for section 3.2
sources.quote: Financial services violations
sources.finding: Section 1 incorporates payment-provider rules. Section 3.2 prohibits unlawful financial services and misleading financial claims; the rule is not a categorical ban on economic journalism.

sources.title: Ko-fi tax responsibilities
sources.quote: It is the creator's responsibility to calculate and remit the appropriate sales tax or VAT due on their sales.
sources.finding: Ko-fi is not merchant of record and does not collect/remit creator VAT or sales tax; creator income reporting remains with the seller.

sources.title: PayPal Vietnam merchant fees
sources.access: BrowserOS Neo; primary web text for rate/destination tables
sources.quote: 4.40% + fixed fee
sources.finding: Vietnam residents' international commercial receipts cost 4.40% plus the currency-specific fixed fee ($0.30 for USD). Withdrawal to a local Vietnamese bank is 60,000 VND when no conversion is involved; FX and other applicable fees are separate.

sources.title: PayPal Vietnam acceptable use
sources.quote: PayPal requires pre-approval to accept payments for certain services as detailed in the chart below.
sources.finding: Buying, selling or brokering investments requires pre-approval. Illegal activity, deceptive schemes and other prohibited activities remain barred. An editorial subscription is not permission to broker investments.

sources.title: PayPal Vietnam user agreement
sources.quote: We recommend business accounts for people and organizations that primarily use PayPal to sell goods or services
sources.finding: Correct residence and business/personal details are required. PayPal may require identity, taxpayer/national identification, address and additional tax documentation; each party remains responsible for its own taxes.

sources.title: Gumroad payouts
sources.quote: Vietnam
sources.finding: The bank-payout country table explicitly lists Vietnam/VND. Local bank, photo ID and residence/business evidence are required. Standard minimum is $100 equivalent; payout review and settlement delays apply. Payoneer and Wise are not supported payout modes.

sources.title: Gumroad fees
sources.quote: Credit card processing (2.9% + $0.30)
sources.finding: Direct sales cost 10% + $0.50, excluding card processing of 2.9% + $0.30 or PayPal fees. Discover is 30% including processing. A high-volume discount is separate from the standard case.

sources.title: Gumroad prohibited products
sources.quote: investment opportunities
sources.finding: The list bars investment-opportunity services, crypto products and advice-framed prediction services. It does not expressly settle the classification of an editorial macro report; uncertainty goes to the provider with the actual sample.

sources.title: Gumroad payout identity settings
sources.quote: Company Tax ID and business registration document (if applicable)
sources.finding: Choose the actual individual/business form; provide legal name, date of birth, address, national ID/photo ID and applicable company/tax documents. This does not establish a universal W-9 or W-8 requirement for a Vietnam seller.

sources.title: Gumroad sales tax
sources.quote: Gumroad now acts as the Merchant of Record for all sales.
sources.finding: Gumroad handles sales-tax collection/remittance on platform transactions; existing reseller reporting may remain. This does not state that a seller's Vietnamese income-tax liability disappears.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy supported countries
sources.quote: Vietnam
sources.finding: Vietnam is explicitly listed for bank payouts. Platform payout support does not require assuming a standalone Vietnam Stripe merchant account is available.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy fees
sources.quote: 1% per payout for bank accounts outside the US
sources.finding: The base example uses 5% + $0.50; additional fees include 1.5% international, 1.5% PayPal and 0.5% subscriptions. Non-US bank payouts cost 1%; non-US PayPal payouts cost 3%, capped at $30. Transaction fees apply to total order value including tax.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy prohibited products
sources.quote: NFT & Crypto related products.
sources.finding: Services, regulated banking/financing/currency-exchange activities, get-rich-quick schemes and crypto-related products are prohibited. The six-market product includes Bitcoin; a macro-only fulfilled PDF is a distinct product classification, not an automatic ban.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy identity verification
sources.quote: upload a photo of your government-issued ID.
sources.finding: Personal information and government ID are required before selling; store activation and periodic re-verification can also apply.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy tax forms
sources.quote: Non-US merchants and affiliates are required to complete a Form W-8
sources.finding: Non-US owners must provide the applicable W-8 details; payout can be disabled until the tax form is complete. US W-9 instructions are a different seller category.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy sales tax and income
sources.quote: you may need to pay tax on the income you receive from Lemon Squeezy in the form of payouts.
sources.finding: As merchant of record it handles buyer sales tax/VAT; seller income tax can remain.

sources.title: Lemon Squeezy store review
sources.quote: eBooks, PDFs, design assets, photos, audio, video, etc.
sources.finding: Fulfilled digital goods can be accepted if not prohibited, following KYC/KYB and product review. The policy distinguishes fulfilled goods from service subscriptions.

sources.title: Paddle supplier countries
sources.quote: Paddle works with software businesses anywhere in the world
sources.finding: Vietnam is absent from Paddle's unsupported supplier-country list. This is country eligibility for an accepted software business, not a promise to accept a financial newsletter.

sources.title: Paddle acceptable use
sources.quote: Investment or financial advice, including trading signals and strategies
sources.finding: Paddle targets software and bars investment/financial advice and trading signals/strategies, with additional restrictions on pure advisory services and community-only access.

sources.title: Paddle master services agreement
sources.quote: Paddle Checkout: 5% of SRP plus $0.50;
sources.finding: Checkout costs 5% + $0.50. Supplier KYC/KYB can include owners, business/product URLs and tax registrations. Paddle administers transaction sales taxes; FX and international transfer costs are separate.

sources.title: Paddle payout schedule
sources.quote: You can receive your payment either via wire transfer or Payoneer.
sources.finding: Monthly payouts have a minimum $100 threshold. Certain destinations incur a $15 SWIFT charge and bank charges can apply. Payoneer availability does not override product restrictions.

sources.title: Patreon international payouts
sources.access: BrowserOS Neo; primary web text for rate/destination tables
sources.quote: Vietnam
sources.finding: Vietnam/VND appears in the bank destination table. USD-to-local-bank payout costs 1.55% + $0.25, with a $10 minimum; PayPal is 1% (min $0.25, cap $20, $10 minimum). Payoneer Wallet is $1 with a $25 minimum, before provider costs.

sources.title: Patreon creator fees
sources.access: BrowserOS Neo; primary web text for USD processing table
sources.finding: New pages use a 10% platform plan. USD card/Apple Pay processing is 2.9% + $0.30; non-US PayPal/Venmo is 3.9% + $0.30. Different member/creator currencies add 2.5%; eligible iOS purchases have Apple's separate 30% fee replacing standard processing.

sources.title: Patreon finance content rule
sources.quote: Works that discuss finance, banking, cryptocurrencies and business topics in an analytical, educational, journalistic, or historical manner are permitted.
sources.finding: The same section prohibits financial advice that promotes/offers/sells investment opportunities or ownership/financial products, MLM schemes and crypto launches. Permission covers the stated analytical formats, not an investment-advice service.

sources.title: Patreon W-8 forms
sources.quote: All creators who are not US citizens must submit a W-8BEN or W-8BEN-E
sources.finding: Patreon requires the applicable non-US tax form to pay out. Complete real legal identity, residence and tax details; treaty benefits cannot be assumed.

sources.title: Patreon payout setup
sources.quote: an automatic 5-day payout lock is placed on your balance.
sources.finding: Payout country and account location must match supplied information; adding/changing payout details triggers a five-day lock. No customer's account has been inspected for eligibility.

sources.title: Patreon account identity verification
sources.access: BrowserOS Neo; primary web text for expanded verification answers
sources.quote: A government-issued photo ID
sources.finding: When enrolled, provide legal name, birth date and identification; a photo, government ID or business documents may be requested. Payouts lock during required verification, separately from payment-provider checks.

sources.title: Patreon supported creator currencies
sources.quote: USD
sources.finding: USD is a supported creator currency; VND is not listed as a selectable creator balance currency. A Vietnam/VND bank destination does not mean VND tier pricing is supported.

sources.title: Payoneer pricing
sources.access: BrowserOS Neo; primary web text for collapsed pricing panels
sources.quote: Up to 3.99% + 0.49 USD or equivalent
sources.finding: Vietnam appears in local-bank withdrawal destinations. Card receipts can cost up to 3.99% + $0.49; US ACH is 1%. Published bank withdrawal corridors range 1.2%-4% or a conditional fixed fee; annual account fee is $29.95 below $6,000 receipts in 12 months, subject to account/region exceptions. Confirm the actual corridor quote.

sources.title: Payoneer prohibited transaction list
sources.quote: Brokerage investment services
sources.finding: The list restricts brokerage/investment services, venture capital/investments and other financial activities. A payment rail is not permission to sell investment products or advice.

sources.title: Payoneer invoice payment requests
sources.quote: Set the amount, add local taxes, currencies, and payment terms.
sources.finding: Business invoices can include applicable taxes. Payoneer is a collection/payment rail; this page does not promise seller income-tax remittance.

sources.title: Payoneer document verification
sources.quote: Your identity
sources.finding: Verification can require government ID, residence evidence and a bank document identifying the bank, account and owner; supply business information where requested.

sources.title: Payoneer payment-request eligibility
sources.quote: request a payment cannot be used as a checkout or payment solution for ecommerce stores.
sources.finding: Request a Payment is for supported B2B categories, not consumer checkout. If a business category is unsupported for requests, the help page describes business receiving-account transfers; all prohibited-transaction rules still apply.

sources.title: Vietcombank corporate transfer tariff
sources.quote: 7.000 VND/món
sources.finding: An unbundled DigiBiz same-bank outgoing transfer is 7,000 VND; non-24/7 interbank outgoing is 0.02%, minimum 20,000 VND, maximum 1,000,000 VND. These are payer-side examples, not Jim's quoted receiving fee; packages, VAT and other banks can differ.

sources.title: Vietcombank corporate representative verification
sources.quote: người đại diện
sources.finding: The bank requires the legal representative's identity/biometric verification for corporate electronic payments; the notice applies from 1 July 2025.

sources.title: Vietnam Tax Department handbook announcement
sources.quote: đăng ký thuế và hóa đơn, khai và nộp thuế
sources.finding: The current household/individual-business workflow includes tax registration, invoices, filing and payment. Seller legal form, turnover and activity are needed to choose the actual treatment; this announcement is not a product-specific tax-rate ruling.

sources.title: Vietnam consolidated Securities Law 102/VBHN-VPQH, Article 4(32) and Article 86(4)
sources.access: Official Gazette public PDF via primary web text
sources.quote: khuyến nghị liên quan đến việc mua, bán, nắm giữ chứng khoán.
sources.finding: Article 4(32) defines securities investment advice through analysis/reports and recommendations to buy/sell/hold securities; Article 86(4) addresses licensed securities-advisory companies. A bank transfer or a disclaimer does not itself decide product classification.

sources.title: Vietcombank organisational account application, form 01b
sources.access: Bank public PDF via primary web text
sources.quote: MÃ SỐ THUẾ (Tax Code)
sources.finding: The application requests organisational tax code, registered identity, business-license information and legal representative identification. It also offers a VND current account.

sources.title: Patreon creator VAT handling
sources.quote: VAT charges are processed and remitted via Patreon
sources.finding: Where Patreon has a collection obligation, applicable member VAT is added, collected and remitted by Patreon; local seller registration/filing obligations are not universally removed.
